title: Short Delivery Quantity Discrepancy
description: Standard dispute: 100 pcs invoiced, 100 pcs dispatched, signed receipt shows only 80 pcs received. Net shortage of 20 pcs. No credit note found.

dispute.message: We received only 80 of the 100 units invoiced on INV-002. Please issue a credit note for 20 units.

expected_findings.statement: Delivery shortage of 20 pcs between invoice INV-REC-002 (100 pcs) and signed receipt POD-REC-002 (80 pcs).
assumptions: Both records refer to item ITEM-01 under shipment SHP-002.
limitations: Other deliveries or adjustments may exist outside the supplied dataset.
expected_findings.next_step: Verify whether the receipt covers the complete shipment or request credit note for 20 pcs.

expected_findings.statement: No credit note found in provided records for the 20 pcs shortage on invoice INV-002.
limitations: A credit note may have been issued in a separate accounting cycle outside this dataset.
expected_findings.next_step: Contact supplier accounts to confirm if a credit note has been issued or approved.

unresolved_questions: Does signed receipt POD-REC-002 represent a partial delivery with a subsequent batch pending?
Was a credit note issued outside the supplied records?
